content.comment_body: Hello, I would appreciate advice on this issue. If I have [product_name] [version_no] software, is it possible to open and configure a [product_name] [version_no] device with it, or do I need to purchase an update to the newer software version? Thank you for your assistance. [user_name]
To work with [product_name] [version_no] hardware, you will need [product_name] [version_no] software. You can find instructions and download the upgrade from [url].

analysis.insight_summary: There is uncertainty among users about compatibility between older software versions and newer hardware. Specifically, users are unsure if their existing [product_name] [version_no] software can be used with the latest hardware, and whether upgrading the software is necessary.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to configure newer hardware with their existing software, and wish to clearly understand if an upgrade is needed without additional cost or difficulty.
